This is all fantasy wishful thinking. A majority of Americans ALWAYS say they are against big government and in favor of individual freedom, when asked in very general terms. But if you ask about specific issues you find that in almost every case the public favors MORE government, not less.

Here's the actual survey results: http://www.gallup.com/poll/180398/cluster-concerns-vie-top-problem-2014.aspx

Gallup's explanation of the results is more plausible:

"With unemployment and gas prices falling, the U.S. not being involved in any major wars and scaling back operations in Afghanistan, and no acts of domestic terrorism occurring, the factors that have caused Americans to converge on a single pressing concern in the past simply weren't present in 2014."
